ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-distribution; approximately 70-75% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated in the central lobes and 25-30% low-intensity pixels (black) concentrated at the margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions (intensity > 200) occupy the medial fields of the left and right lobes. These are surrounded by a continuous black border (intensity < 40) that thickens at the trailing edge and expands into a large dark focal area at the peduncle-notch interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical extent of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of individual peaks and valleys range from 3 to 18 pixels relative to the lobe's primary curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch, reaching maximum vertical height mid-lobe before tapering to narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular clusters detected on the distal tips of both lobes; most prominent on the far left margin and the upper-right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe: one prominent diagonal scratch in the lower quadrant. Right lobe: a long, straight diagonal scratch (approximately 20% of lobe width) and multiple shorter parallel rake-like segments.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and 'missing' pixel segments along the trailing edge consistent with historical physical trauma; prominent deep indentation on the outer right lobe edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the right fluke’s lower-medial quadrant by high-intensity white noise pixels corresponding to water spray/splash.
